abstract: Tracks cross-border regulatory filings and biological substance transit authorisations
system_message:
You are the Regulatory compliance officer (REG), responsible for tracking cross-border regulatory filings and biological substance transit authorisations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Customs clearance protocols（CUSTOM）
information_points.content:
REG-CUSTOM-AA9：Under the customs facilitation accord across designated international air freight transit hubs, Vanguard Bio-Transit Network maintains an expedited import pre-clearance window of 4 h for processing bonded biological cargo before customs release.
REG-CUSTOM-U1R：Under the customs facilitation accord across designated international air freight transit hubs, Polaris Life Sciences Freight maintains an expedited import pre-clearance window of 8 h for processing bonded biological cargo before customs release.
REG-CUSTOM-DG5：Under the customs facilitation accord across designated international air freight transit hubs, Apex Cryo-Logistics Alliance maintains an expedited import pre-clearance window of 12 h for processing bonded biological cargo before customs release.

information_points.title: Tracks cross-border regulatory filings and biological substance transit authorisations（PERM）
information_points.content:
REG-PERM-WT8：For operations within the licensed province of Guangdong, Polaris Life Sciences Freight holds an approved biological substance transport permit authorizing the carriage of Category B infectious biological cargo.
REG-PERM-UTA：For regulatory filings covering the licensed province of Zhejiang, Polaris Life Sciences Freight does not have an approved biological substance transport permit for Category B infectious cargo.
REG-PERM-MSD：Regarding commercial transit routes within the licensed province of Guangdong, Apex Cryo-Logistics Alliance does not have an approved biological substance transport permit for Category B infectious biological materials.
REG-PERM-58F：Within the licensed province of Guangdong, Vanguard Bio-Transit Network holds an approved biological substance transport permit covering Category B infectious biological substances.
